title: The box, not opened
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the fireworks box, closed, behind the counter, the dog against it. The owner says open it. Wood says the third. She says it's a drawing. He says the uncle said the third. She lets that stand. Everyone knows the uncle.

panels.composition: The cover: a cardboard box behind a counter, closed, a warning as blocks, a small dog asleep against it.

panels.composition: The owner. A beat. Letting it stand.

panels.composition: The digest in the rack. The closed box facing the room. Everyone knows the uncle; the rack does too.
